name: Messier 32
tagline: Andromeda's compact elliptical satellite — a galaxy stripped to its dense core by repeated close passes.
history: M32 is the bright compact elliptical projected against Andromeda's southern disc — a galaxy whose outskirts were probably sheared away by repeated plunges through M31. What survives is a dense stellar core: centrally concentrated, high surface brightness, with a supermassive black hole of a few million Suns at its heart. Its ongoing interaction is written across M31's disc in rings and warps traced by infrared surveys.
